author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: नञ्द्वयमादरार्थः ।  कुतं इत्यत उक्तम् ॥  न हीति ।  कल्याणकृत् श्रद्ध्या किञ्चित्कालं ध्यानादिकृदित्यर्थः
translation: V. The destruction here is to be born as lower animals; and the destruction there is to be damned in hell. Neither of these evil results befalls him, who has fallen from Yoga. That .........righteous : who practises meditation and other pious duties with faith. (40)
